hardware.locator: Horowitz, ISSCC 2014 accompanying presentation, slide 32 of 46
hardware.context: Rough 45 nm per-event estimates. Memory access width: 64 bits. These operations do different work; this is not an intelligence-efficiency ranking.

biology.context: ATP-equivalent biochemical estimates compared with sequence-writing bounds under an idealized uniform alphabet. Each ratio has its own operation-specific denominator, k_B T ln(alphabet size). No organism-level efficiency is inferred.

illustrative_brain_arithmetic.context: An illustration of mismatched measurement levels, not plotted as an efficiency ranking. Whole-brain power divided by behavioural output throughput is not reset energy or total internal computation.

audit.notes: The DRAM interval is the source's rough range, not a confidence interval. No LLM, neuron, or synapse estimates are inferred from TDP, peak FLOPS, or unspecified signal definitions.
